column1: # span_cards/slot/enter/fixtures.tsv — J5's `enter` fixtures (span_cards.md §2.3; art.py reads it, plan.py keys it).
# THE FIXTURE RULE (art.py's header states it in full): for (kind, entry), a census0 corpus unit (sweep.jsonl, RTE, rc 0)
# of that site_kind whose CHOSEN alternative (wr.alt, the entry the consumer is entered with) has that entry and at least
# two non-FULL verify-YES positions (so a FAIL candidate exists: its last verify position, the highest window offset that
# is not the stop, fails); row-1-class units first (census0's population); the window starts at the match start and the
# pattern needs at least one byte past it (die1 is a consumer death; kind 6 REPORT excepted: the window IS the match);
# python re's semantics the same; the shortest such pattern. A pair no unit reaches has pattern `-` and the reason.
# Fields: window = per-position byte choices `|`-separated (copied from the unit's sets; the FIRST byte of each is the
# plants' canonical text); stop = the unit's stop offset; pre = bytes before every candidate and plant; die = the byte
# one past the window (pass); fail = the byte put at the last verify position (fail); live = the suffix that makes
# pre+window+live a real match (the plants); filler = the alphabet between them. Escapes: \n \t \\ \xHH.
